title: Compatibility under restriction extension
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $T$ be a DNF term on $n$ sign coordinates, and let $\rho,\eta$ be coordinate restrictions such that every coordinate fixed by $\rho$ has the same fixed value in $\eta$. If $T$ is compatible with $\eta$, then $T$ is compatible with $\rho$.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a DNF term on $n$ sign coordinates
$\rho$ and $\eta$ are coordinate restrictions on $n$ coordinates
Every coordinate fixed by $\rho$ has the same restriction in $\eta$
